Announce.Name: Announce in Chat
Announce.Hint: Post a chat card listing what changed whenever a profile is equipped.

StyleMenu.Name: Slot Icons
StyleMenu.Label: Configure Slot Icons
StyleMenu.Hint: Pick the empty-slot icons and their color and hue.

Unequipped.Name: Unequipped Weapons
Unequipped.Hint: Gray out unequipped weapons on the combat tab, and ask before attacking with one.

Unequipped.Title: Weapon Not Equipped
Unequipped.Body: {item} isn't equipped. Attack with it anyway?

Live.Title: Equipment: {actor}
Live.Name: Equipment
Live.OverwriteConfirm: Replace {profile} with what {actor} has equipped now?

Window.Title: Equipment Profile: {actor}
Window.OtherHint: Other Equipped: drop extra weapons or slotless items here

StyleConfig.Title: Slot Icons
StyleConfig.HintPick: Click a slot to pick its image.
StyleConfig.HintReset: Right-click a slot to go back to the built-in icon.
StyleConfig.TintHint: Turns images into silhouettes in this color. Needs a transparent background.

ActorSlots.Title: Disabled Equipment Slots
ActorSlots.Hint: Checked slots are hidden in the equipment window, and nothing can be equipped in them.

Sheet.Title: Equipment Profiles
Sheet.LayerHint: Goes in the Over Armor slot, on top of another suit.

Report.NoLongerFits: Skipped, no longer fits its slot: {items}.
Report.Stale: Skipped, changed while waiting for approval: {items}.

Warn.Pending: An equipment change for {actor} is already waiting for approval.
Warn.GateFailed: Equip approval "{gate}" failed; nothing was changed. See the console.
Warn.HeldHidden: {item}: these actions set their own grip, so the profile's grip won't reach them: {actions}.
Warn.NotThisActor: Only this actor's own items can be assigned.
Warn.OffHandLocked: That weapon is always two-handed; only a buckler can go in the off hand.
Warn.SlotDisabled: {item} can't be equipped: {slot} is disabled for {actor}.
Warn.EquippedInDisabled: {item} is equipped, but {slot} is disabled for this character.

LayerOverHeavy.coat: {item} has no effect over heavy armor.
LayerOverHeavy.kilt: {item} adds no armor bonus over heavy armor.

Grips.Label: Grips
Grips.Hint: Grips this can be wielded with. The default follows Type and Hands.
Grips.ChipInvalid: Not allowed now: click to fix.

Hands.FreeFirst: Free the hand first and nothing is unequipped.
Hands.Lapsed: {item}: a grip rule on {actor} has ended.

Conflict.InvalidGrip: {item} is held in a grip it can't take now.

Use.Title: Grip Not Allowed
Use.Body: {item} is held in a grip it can't take now.

Unmet.Title: Needs {needs}
Unmet.Body: {profile} needs {needs}. Without it, {items} can't be equipped.
